note: The salon map (SalonMapScreen on Android, Features/Map on iOS), from the iPhone capture of the demo world: invented salons on the real Kabul map. Facts checked 2026-09-24: iOS live on the App Store (Afghanistan storefront only, since 2026-09-21, app-store/metadata.md) and Android on Google Play (since 2026-08-28) — the generator prints both store names in the footer; safebeauty.web.app/get stays the one printed link and sends each phone to its own store. Salons are in Kabul only — no second city, no count. No promotion running. Every salon, name, price and time on a screen is the invented demo world from marketing/demo/ — nothing real.
